name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A tool that uses Claude Code to read job postings, rewrite your CV and cover letter to fit each one, and coach you for the interview — like a personal job-search assistant that lives in your terminal.
buyer: A laid-off professional (the creator was a geophysicist) doing a serious job search, or a career coach who wants to offer AI-tailored applications to clients.
business_use_cases: A career coach runs this for each client's job search instead of manually editing CVs for every application.
A laid-off professional applies to 50+ tailored roles in the time it used to take to do 5, the way the creator landed a signed offer.
A university career center sets it up on lab machines so students get tailored cover letters without hiring more advisors.

money_ideas.idea: Career coaches charge clients a flat fee per application cycle, using this instead of billing hourly for CV edits.
Build a hosted, no-setup version for non-technical job seekers who can't install Claude Code, LaTeX, and Python themselves.

steal_this: Package the /setup, /scrape, /apply flow as a hosted web app with a simple upload-your-resume onboarding, so non-technical job seekers skip the Python/LaTeX/CLI setup entirely.
